n: Event <Crux of the Jungle> is now open

list: Unlock all the stories in Crux of the Jungle

The tiny factor that set off the upheaval lies hidden between the lines of the reports. Read through them, and you will understand everything.
It lurks in the jungle, or circles overhead. It is gently flapping its wings. It is every person here.
During the Crux of the Jungle event, obtain the outfit Holiday HDm25

A medal Insider personally handed you before his vacation ended, in thanks for arranging such a rare and unforgettable vacation for him.
He also gave you a bag of cookies he baked with ingredients from the seaside. The cool, refreshing flavor you taste in them is the perfect match for summer.
